00066 void WrapUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00067 {
00068  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00069  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00070  float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00071  float* lowerSamples = inputs[Lower].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00072  float* upperSamples = inputs[Upper].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00073  
00074  while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00075  {
00076   *outputSamples++ = wrap(*inputSamples++, *lowerSamples++, *upperSamples++);
00077  }
00078 }

00106 Wrap::Wrap(WrapFold_InputsWithTypesOnly) throw()
00107 {
00108  if((upper.getNumChannels() == 1) && upper.isConst(0) && (upper.getValue(0) == 0.f))
00109  {
00110   UGen const& rightOperand = lower; // is now actually upper!
00111   UGen inputs[] = { input, rightOperand };
00112   const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputChannels(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);
00113   initInternal(numInputChannels);
00114   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00115   {
00116    internalUGens[i] = new BinaryWrapUGenInternal(input, rightOperand);
00117    internalUGens[i]->initValue(ugen::wrap(input.getValue(i), rightOperand.getValue(i)));
00118   }    
00119  }
00120  else
00121  {
00122   UGen inputs[] = { WrapFold_InputsNoTypes };
00123   const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputChannels(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);
00124   initInternal(numInputChannels);
00125   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00126   {
00127    internalUGens[i] = new WrapUGenInternal(WrapFold_InputsNoTypes);
00128    internalUGens[i]->initValue(ugen::wrap(input.getValue(i), 
00129                lower.getValue(i),
00130                upper.getValue(i)));
00131   }
00132  }
00133 }
